name: motion-kit
description: Describe a video in plain English, Hindi or Hinglish and get a finished motion graphic (MP4 + cover image): storyboard, matching colours, voice-synced timing and sound, rendered from tested scene templates. Bundles the motion-kit engine, the motion-director skill (text to rendered video) and the motion-creative-director skill (concepts, storyboards and per-shot prompts for AI video tools, from a frame-by-frame study of premium SaaS launch films).
